answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the dune of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. A inlet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the signal of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on receipt hashes checked against public logs before trust.
